title: A Multidisciplinary Survey and Framework for Design and Evaluation of Explainable AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a framework for designing and evaluating Explainable AI (XAI) systems across disciplines like machine learning, HCI, and visualization.
